data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure (caniuse lookup, MDN search and URL, then drafting the mail with the right subject and body) and the parameters are essentially right (recipient_name and recipient_email stand in for customer). It loses points because it ends with "Send" when the true workflow says never to send and to Discard the draft and close the MDN tab, it omits the "not supported" case, and it has the name/recipient_email redundancy and the {name} vs recipient_name inconsistency.
